purpose: independent decoder correctness/conformance gate after Stage-5 Pilot-B direct-token replay

bins.oracle: independent Python Fisher-Yates + floor bin boundaries + MSB bin bits

arithmetic_coding.oracle: independent ADR-0007 integer allocation, common-prefix and renormalization

adg.oracle: independent Stage-4 paper Algorithm-1 partition + little-endian group-index inverse

discop.oracle: independent pinned Cython translation with persistent sender/receiver PRNG state

dairstega.oracle: independent paper/ADR interval allocation + posterior-window state transition

interpretation: PASS means each normalized streaming decoder agrees with a decoder oracle implemented outside the production method helpers on deterministic synthetic fixtures. It complements, but does not replace, the 504-run direct-token replay.
